FAQ

Common questions.

The stuff customers ask us most. If you don't see your question, just give us a call.

Still have questions?

We're happy to talk through your project. No pressure.

📞 (361) 903-9077 →

Standard rental is up to 7 days. Need more time? Just ask — we work with you on the schedule.

Most household junk, construction debris, yard waste, roofing materials, furniture, appliances (with restrictions on fridges/ACs containing freon), wood, drywall, flooring, and most non-hazardous materials.

No hazardous materials — paint, chemicals, batteries, tires, propane tanks, motor oil, asbestos, medical waste, or anything wet/liquid. If you're not sure about a specific item, just ask us.

We use wood planks under the wheels to protect concrete and asphalt. We've done thousands of driveway drops without damage. Where we park is always your call.

If the dumpster sits on your private property (driveway, yard), no permit needed. If it has to sit on a public street, your city may require one — call your city or HOA to check. We can guide you through it.

Don't overload. By law we can't haul a dumpster that's filled above the top — items have to stay level with the rim. Overweight loads can result in additional fees or we may ask you to remove material before pickup.

Most jobs in our service area get same-week delivery. Same-day or next-day is often possible — just call. Emergency storm cleanup? We move fast.

Flat-rate pricing. We confirm the total when you book — no surprise fees. We accept card, cash, and digital payments. Card payments go through Square.

Yes — sheds, fences, decks, garages, mobile homes, small structures. We bring the dumpster AND tear it down. One-stop call. Bigger demo jobs get a free in-person quote.

That's our junk removal service. You point, we load. No dumpster sitting in your driveway — we come with the truck, take it, and we're gone. Great for single items, furniture, appliances, or estate cleanouts.
